name: remove-dead-sample-packages-and-cruft-v2
title: Remove dead sample packages and committed cruft for the open-source release
description: Pre-open-source cleanup. Three sample/dogfood projects under packages/ (cli-guess-number, python-demo, python-rps) and two tracked junk/dead files at the repo root (du.exe.stackdump, claude-session.mjs) are not part of the Lattice tool and have zero live references; delete them so the OSS repo ships only the actual product. jek.md is deliberately KEPT (user-owned per decisions/root-markdown-migration-execution-solution.md; the user confirmed keeping it). packages/lab and experiments/ are also out of scope (separate follow-up).

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: the keyword migration only appears as part of a cited decision-doc filename (decisions/root-markdown-migration-execution-solution.md) and the phrase migration story, not because this story performs any data migration. This story only deletes confirmed-dead, unreferenced sample packages and two cruft files; there is no data migration or schema/state migration involved.
